title: Incidents and Pull Requests Degraded Availability
body_text: We are investigating reports of degraded availability for Issues and Pull Requests. Users may see delayed webhook delivery and timeouts loading PR diffs.
reference_summary: A backend service handling PR diff rendering became overloaded, causing timeouts and delayed webhook delivery; mitigated by scaling the affected service and clearing the backlog queue.

title: Widespread 500 errors across multiple services
body_text: A change to our edge network configuration caused a spike in 500 errors for HTTP requests routed through affected data centers.
reference_summary: A bad edge configuration change propagated globally and caused request failures; rolled back the configuration change to restore service.

title: Elevated API error rates for Payment Intents
body_text: We identified elevated error rates for the Payment Intents API caused by increased latency in an upstream database.
reference_summary: Upstream database latency caused elevated error rates on Payment Intents; mitigated by failing over to a healthy database replica.

title: Delayed metric ingestion in US1 region
body_text: Customers may observe delays in metric and log ingestion in the US1 region due to a capacity issue in our intake pipeline.
reference_summary: A capacity shortfall in the intake pipeline delayed metric/log ingestion in US1; resolved by adding intake capacity.

title: SMS delivery delays in EU region
body_text: We are seeing delays in SMS message delivery for customers sending messages through EU carriers, currently investigating with upstream partners.
reference_summary: An upstream EU carrier partner experienced delivery delays; Twilio rerouted traffic to alternate carrier routes to mitigate.
